positive: Editorial still-life photograph, a thick square swatch of saddle-tan bonded polyurethane faux leather lying flat, perfectly uniform embossed grain pattern repeating across the surface, no pores, slight plastic sheen, one corner gently curled, its cut edge showing a thin coloured skin over a pale woven fabric backing. One single warm tungsten light source from the low left, about 3200K, casting one long soft shadow with gentle falloff across a deep espresso-brown matte ground, low-key exposure, most of the frame in soft shadow. Muted desaturated colour grade, matte surfaces, no gloss, no reflections. Shallow depth of field, 85mm macro lens, fine film grain, quiet luxury interior magazine photography. Empty frame, only the object. No people, no hands, no text.
